scope: Executed local synthetic development pass; real captures deferred by user. Implemented tooling and exploratory experiments do not imply phase acceptance.

phase_status.P3: Completed original study; overall acceptance failed and remains unchanged.
phase_status.P4: Exploratory paired-reference control encoder trained and tested with known DSP decoder on one synthetic effect family. Joint latent-conditioned hybrid, replicated families and listening acceptance remain open.
phase_status.P5: Native C++ renderer and explicit recurrent ONNX state implemented. Audio/state parity passed. Short native timing screens passed for final preview, but 600-second sustained timing failed; internal allocation audit remains open.
phase_status.P6: Standalone/VST3 built and packaged. Official validator and local synthetic host checks passed. Named DAW, listener, clean-machine and release acceptance remain open.

report.interpretation: Negative or inconclusive results remain valid. Synthetic acceptance does not establish hardware fidelity, native real-time behavior, or reference transfer. Bootstrap intervals are exploratory with three seeds.

report.scope: New single-seed development protocol after P3. Exact dry/wet mix law, mixed controls in training, unseen-drive and unseen-mix validation. Not a replacement for completed P3 or a superiority claim.

report.research_claim: not tested; a single run does not establish hybrid superiority

control_v2.qualification: New data seed, width, controls and training budget; single development run, not a controlled P3 ablation or hybrid-superiority result.

report.scope: Synthetic paired-reference control inference with known DSP decoder; exploratory P4 baseline
report.limitations: No joint audio-backbone training, no real captures, no subjective study; estimates require paired and already aligned reference dry/wet audio.
